instruction: Open or import the initial file(s) from the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\fixture_complex.step. Set the four fixture blocks in C:\Users\User\Desktop\fixture_complex.step as fixture or avoidance geometry. Create safe toolpaths for the central pocket and outside profile while maintaining at least 4 mm clearance from every fixture whenever Z is below 20 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 12 mm end mill for roughing and T2 is a 6 mm end mill for finishing while respecting fixtures. Use the SolidCAM CAM-Part, Coordinate System, Stock, Tool Table, operation, simulation/verify, and post-processing dialogs as needed, then save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-17.nc.
